name: weekly-picks
title_zh: NFL 周赛阵容，先看盘口再看伤病的选人流程
tagline_zh: 每周 DraftKings 现金赛与 GPP 阵容，从 Vegas 赔率、伤病、使用率、天气到教练倾向逐层筛。
tagline_en: Weekly DraftKings cash & GPP picks via Vegas lines, injuries, usage, weather, coaching — each rec with reasoning.
desc_en: Run the weekly DraftKings NFL research process — analyze the slate (Vegas lines, injuries, usage, weather, coaching tendencies) and recommend cash-game and GPP player picks with reasoning. Use when the user asks for weekly picks, who to play, lineup help, or slate research.
why_zh: 把职业 DFS 玩家的周赛研究流程固化成可复用的步骤，每个推荐都带可追溯的推理链。
why_en: Encodes a pro DFS weekly research loop into repeatable steps; every pick carries a visible reasoning chain instead of a bare.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 NFL 常规赛周赛的 DraftKings 选人，不含 NBA/NHL/MLB；需要你手动提供当周赛程。
limit_en: NFL regular-season DraftKings only; you supply slate data (odds, injuries, weather) manually; outputs picks with rationale, no payout guarantee.
title_en: NFL weekly DFS picks: odds-first, injury-aware lineup.
